# vendor

`bedstead.otf` is [Bedstead](https://bjh21.me.uk/bedstead/) version 002.002 by
Ben Harris, an outline font that reproduces the SAA5050 teletext character
generator. It is dedicated to the public domain (CC0-1.0). This copy came from
the npm package `@techandsoftware/teletext-fonts`.

It is only used by `npm run glyphs`, which turns the outlines into
`src/teletext/glyphs.ts`. The cards never load the font itself.
